publication_metadata.summary: In 1284, part of the highest stone vaults of the Middle Ages fell at Beauvais; others from the same age still stand. This documentary explains how Gothic builders raised stone so high: the pointed arch, the rib vault, the flying buttress, walls of light, and geometry in place of calculation, and where the limit lay.
